race.comment: OUTBACK THUNDER (5) was a winner two back when leading throughout but drifted back latest and safely held when 8th and beaten 11 lengths at this track (22.81). Worth another chance. JAKARI ZARA (1) returned a better run last time, finishing in the money (22.10) at this track behind Miss Target in a Grade 6. Expected to feature again. FARMOR SURELY (2) has been mixing form lately, hitting the frame two back before finishing fourth (24.25) at Rockhampton in a Grade 6. Expected to do much better this time. SILVER SQUEEZE (7) will have admirers again after placing at this track and distance last time out.
